name: Good lead: 3BHK Kothrud, books a consultation

fields.scope_summary: Full 3BHK: kitchen, living room, both bedrooms
fields.preferences_and_concerns: Modular kitchen, wardrobes, warm wood tones

transcript:
Agent: Good evening, Aangan Studio.
Caller: I have a 3BHK in Kothrud and want the whole flat designed and built.
Agent: Lovely. When would you need it complete?
Caller: By March. My husband is happy for me to go ahead.
